sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: Structure and Guidelines:

The ITR-7 Form in India applies to specific organizations and institutions, which can claim exemption from income tax under specific provisions of the Income Tax Act. However, it is also used for companies or individuals for income tax reporting; it may not be directly related to compliance by the organization with public interests or charitable and political organizations and educational and supportive institutions, such as, for example, charitable trusts, political parties, research bodies, and educational institutions that operate primarily in the public interest.
Purpose: The ITR-7 Form is applicable to entities claiming exemption from taxation under the sections of the Income Tax Act.
Applicable To: Such as trusts, political parties, research institutions, and educational bodies.
Structure: Essentially, it comprises Part A (general info), Part B (income & tax computation), and 19 schedules.
Mode of Filing: Exclusively via online mode through the Income Tax e-filing portal.
Verification: Conducted through DSC or EVC/Aadhaar; must be completed within 30 days from the date of submission.
Due dates: For non-audit cases, it is September 15; for audits, it is October 31.
Objective: Compliance of exempt organizations with accurate and transparent reporting.
The ITR-7 Form is a particular Income Tax Return filing form that is used by entities qualifying for an exemption under the provisions of Sections 139(4A) to 139(4D) of the Income Tax Act.
Generally, these entities include:
Section 139(4A): Charitable and religious trusts.
Section 139(4B): Political parties.
Section 139(4C): Scientific research institutions, universities, hospitals, news agencies, and Khadi and village industries.
Section 139(4D): Educational institutions like colleges and universities.

Can a trust file ITR-6 instead of ITR-7?
No. Trusts claiming exemption must use ITR-7; ITR-6 is for companies without Section 11 exemptions.
Is offline filing of ITR-7 possible now?
No. Filing must be done online via the e-filing portal. Physical forms or attachments are not accepted.
Do co-signed returns require both signatories?
No. Only one authorized signatory needs to sign/verify the online return via DSC/EVC.
Can educational institutes claim late filing under concessional rates?
Yes, but filing late may result in penalties under Section 234F; this applies even to entities using ITR-7
Is there a difference between ITR-7 forms across years?
Yes. CBDT updates the form every year since most changes take place with amendments in the budget and tax laws. Always download the latest version for your AY.
